theorems.name: Submission.cmrc_massOn_le_of_repr
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), T.massOn W ≤ μ W
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
